overview: The Medford Energy and Environment Committee met to review administrative updates, defer the selection of 2024 committee co-chairs, and discuss draft revisions to the city's tree ordinances. Staff also presented updates on local electrification projects, municipal EV charging stations, and state climate policy developments.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the November meeting.

items.title: Administrative and City Council Updates
items.summary: Staff reported on introductory meetings with newly elected city council members regarding climate action and comprehensive plans.

items.title: Selection of 2024 Committee Co-Chairs
items.summary: The committee voted to defer the selection of 2024 co-chairs until the January meeting.

items.title: Meeting Attendance and January Format
items.summary: Staff reviewed attendance reporting guidelines, and the committee voted to hold its January 8 meeting in person with a hybrid option.

items.title: Winter Extravaganza Outreach Recap
items.summary: Staff and committee members shared resident feedback on energy assessments and financial barriers collected at the Winter Extravaganza event.

items.title: Tree Ordinance Revisions Discussion
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed revisions to public and private tree ordinances alongside representatives from Trees Medford and agreed to examine an updated consolidated draft in January.

items.title: Municipal Climate Update
items.summary: Staff provided updates on the specialized energy code, EV charging station installations, school bus electrification planning, and state climate policy recommendations.
